content: Behavior trees in JS/TS: mistreevous 4.3.1 (TS, browser+Node, JSON or MDSL DSL, async/promise actions, lifecycle callbacks, subtrees, guards, and built-in seedable RNG for deterministic tree processing — the strongest determinism fit). Alternatives: behavior3js (optimized for many agents, JSON load/save, older), @bt-studio/core (TS, typed, 12 hooks, TSX/builder, zero-dep, inspector). For a deterministic sim, prefer a library whose randomness is injected/seeded and whose tick is pure, or a small in-house tree to fully control determinism.
